name: lens-mcp
description: An independent review layer for AI-generated text: a 10-lens gate run by a separate model over output it did not write.
long_description:
Runs a fixed set of ten named checks over text a model produced, on a separate model from the one that wrote it, and returns the flagged line and the reason for each check rather than a single opaque verdict. Any number it reports is derived mechanically from violation counts — the judging model never emits a grade. A check that cannot complete reports unknown rather than a pass, so silence is never read as approval.

lens_health needs no key. validate_content and scrub_pii need a free key, self-serve at https://api.soulfield.one/pricing#signup.
